notes: Workflow behaviour only (design-system-agnostic). QBDS correctness is covered in evals/qbds-library.

evals.name: staged-gates
evals.prompt: I need a React page showing team utilisation with a filter and a table. Plan it with me first, don't build yet.
evals.expected_output: Starts at requirements, asks plain-language open questions, presents Markdown summary before JSON, writes no UI code, does not open later-stage docs early.

expectations.text: Stays in stage 1 and asks questions in full sentences, not slug keys.
Presents Markdown summary with JSON last.
Writes no UI code before ui_structure is confirmed.

evals.name: just-build
evals.prompt: Just build: a settings page with a profile form in our existing app at apps/web, route /settings. Use the sidebar shell already there.
evals.expected_output: Skips confirmation gates, still fills requirements/UX/UI structure, delivery mode is pages with hostApp/route/mount/targets set, builds inside targets only.

expectations.text: Sets delivery.mode to pages with hostApp, route, mount and targets.
Reuses the host shell instead of creating parallel chrome.

evals.name: re-run-on-change
evals.prompt: We already confirmed the plan, but now the audience is ops leads, not analysts, and the overview needs a weekly summary instead of live metrics. Update it.
evals.expected_output: Says what invalidated, sets later stages to pending, re-confirms from requirements, does not keep coding on the stale plan.
